textRuns.value: Sources: ENTSO-E (wind onshore + offshore generation), Open-Meteo (wind 10 m above ground at each country's cities), Eurostat (population). City wind shows how windy a country is, not wind at turbine height or offshore. Output per person stands in for installed capacity (not in the warehouse), so "room to grow" is a pointer, not a verdict. Only country-years with at least 95 % of days covered count (Cyprus: none). Ireland = all-island market. Bulgaria and Malta are excluded.
